text.tspan: No El Niño on record has been this
strong this early in the year
Each line is one year of the Oceanic Niño Index, from June to the next May;
shaded peaks are El Niño months, when the Pacific runs at least 0.5°C
warmer than normal. At +2.16°C in July to September 2026, this year is
ahead of 1997 (+1.79°C) and 2015 (+1.73°C) at the same point.
Source: NOAA Climate Prediction Center (ONI, ERSSTv5)
